charts.title: Wolf 503 b: orbits around Wolf 503
charts.description: The orbits of Wolf 503's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Wolf 503 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Polanski et al. 2021 (2021AJ....162..238P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname POLANSKI_ET_AL__2021): P 6.00127 d

charts.title: Wolf 503 b: its transit
charts.description: Wolf 503 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 187278212, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 28 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 39 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 28 min late; 5-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 13 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
